tips.label: 先看前面的動詞
tips.text: want、need、plan、learn、decide、would like 後接 to V；enjoy、keep、practice、finish 後接 V-ing。

tips.label: 叫某人做事
tips.text: want／ask／tell + 人 + to V；叫某人不要做事，用 not to V。

tips.label: 介系詞之後
tips.text: without、for、of、about 後面若接動作，要用 V-ing。

tips.label: 有些兩種都可以
tips.text: like、love、begin、start 後可接 to V 或 V-ing；本課的一般情境中意思相近。

tips.label: 先分清楚做了沒
tips.text: remember／forget + to V 指要做的事；+ V-ing 指已做過的事。

tips.label: 停止還是停下來做
tips.text: stop V-ing 是停止原本的動作；stop to V 是停下原本的事，去做另一件事。

tips.label: 整個活動當主詞
tips.text: 一個 V-ing 片語當主詞，通常搭配單數動詞；不要被片語裡的複數名詞誤導。

tips.label: 看到 It is 找 to V
tips.text: It is + 形容詞 + (for 人) + to V；真正談的活動放在後面的不定詞片語。

notes.title: 不定詞當動詞的受詞
notes.rule: 主詞 + want／need／plan／learn／decide／would like + to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 這些動詞後面接另一個動作時，使用不定詞 to V。前面的動詞可依時態變化，to 後面的動詞仍用原形，不因 yesterday 改成過去式。
examples: The singer plans to make a new video.（這位歌手計畫製作新影片。）
They decided to help the housewife yesterday.（他們昨天決定幫助那位家庭主婦。）
I would like to learn to play the guitar.（我想學彈吉他。）

notes.title: 要求某人做事與不定詞的否定
notes.rule: want／ask／tell + 人 + to V；not to V
notes.description: want 可以直接接 to V，也可以接「人 + to V」。tell 表示叫某人做事時，使用 tell + 人 + to V；ask 表示要求某人做事時也用此句型。否定不定詞時把 not 放在 to 前。decide／plan 等後面也可用 not to V。
examples: The reporter asked me to wait outside.（記者請我在外面等。）
Mom told me not to stay up.（媽媽叫我不要熬夜。）
We decided not to buy the camera.（我們決定不買這臺相機。）

notes.title: 動名詞當動詞的受詞
notes.description: 這些動詞後面的動作要改成動名詞。第一個動詞的時態改變，不會改變後面要用 V-ing 的規則。V-ing 常見拼法：play → playing、write → writing、run → running。
examples: The actress enjoys dancing.（這位女演員喜歡跳舞。）
The writer finished writing the story yesterday.（這位作家昨天寫完故事。）
The teenagers kept practicing the song.（青少年們不斷練習那首歌。）

notes.title: 動名詞當介系詞的受詞
notes.description: without、for、of、about 等介系詞後若接動作，要用動名詞。without telling 表示「沒有告知就……」。判斷時先找到介系詞，不要把後面的動作改成 to V。
examples: The actor left without saying goodbye.（這位男演員沒道別就離開了。）
Thanks for helping me.（謝謝你幫助我。）
She dreams of becoming a singer.（她夢想成為歌手。）

notes.title: 不定詞、動名詞皆可的動詞
notes.description: 在本課的一般喜好或開始活動情境中，兩種形式通常都可使用，意思相近。若選項同時出現兩種正確形式，不能只憑背誦任選一個。本教材會避免這種雙解選項。
examples: I like listening to music. = I like to listen to music.（我喜歡聽音樂。）
The singer started to sing. = The singer started singing.（這位歌手開始唱歌。）

notes.title: stop：停止原本的事，或停下來做另一件事
notes.rule: stop V-ing：停止正在做的事；stop to V：停下來去做另一件事
notes.description: 根據前後文判斷動作是否原本正在進行。正在打鼓，因為太吵而停下，用 stop playing；正在走路，因為口渴而停下喝水，用 stop to drink。stop to V 中的不定詞表示停下來的目的。
examples: The boy stopped playing the drums because the baby was asleep.（男孩因為寶寶睡著而停止打鼓。）
The mailman stopped to drink some water.（郵差停下來喝了些水。）

notes.title: remember：記得要做，或記得做過
notes.rule: remember to V：記得要做某事；remember V-ing：記得已做過某事
notes.description: 提醒尚未進行的事情時用 remember to V。描述對已發生事件的記憶時用 remember V-ing。remembered to V 通常表示當時有記得去做，而且做了；remembered V-ing 強調記得那段經歷。
examples: Remember to bring your camera tomorrow.（記得明天帶相機。）
I remember meeting that famous writer last year.（我記得去年見過那位有名的作家。）

notes.title: forget：忘記要做，或忘記做過
notes.rule: forget to V：忘記要做，結果沒做；forget V-ing：事情做過，但忘了那段經歷
notes.description: 看結果判斷：忘記寄信，信還在桌上，用 forgot to send；信已經寄了，卻忘記自己寄過，用 forgot sending。不要只看 yesterday 等時間詞，要看動作是否已完成。
examples: He forgot to buy the gift, so he arrived without one.（他忘記買禮物，所以空手到了。）
She forgot sending the email and sent it again.（她忘了已經寄過那封電子郵件，又寄了一次。）

notes.title: 動名詞片語當主詞
notes.rule: V-ing 片語 + 單數動詞；兩個獨立活動 + and + 複數動詞
notes.description: 一個活動作主詞時，把整段當成一件事，即使裡面有 drums、friends 等複數名詞，也通常配 is。兩個各自獨立的活動用 and 連接時，通常配 are；若語意上視為一個整體，可能用單數，本課題目會提供清楚的獨立活動語境。
examples: Playing the drums is exciting.（打鼓令人興奮。）
Talking with friends is fun.（和朋友聊天很有趣。）
Singing and swimming are two different activities.（唱歌和游泳是兩種不同的活動。）

notes.title: 虛主詞 it 與句型轉換
notes.rule: It + be 動詞 + 形容詞 + (for 人) + to V
notes.description: it 先占主詞位置，真正談的活動用不定詞放在後面。對某人而言可用 for + 人，代名詞用受格，如 for me／him／them。動名詞主詞可改寫為此句型。不定詞片語本身也能當主詞，因此不能把 To play... 當成必然錯誤的選項。
examples: Making videos is interesting. = It is interesting to make videos.（製作影片很有趣。）
Playing the guitar is easy for her. = It is easy for her to play the guitar.（彈吉他對她來說很容易。）
It is important for us to help one another.（互相幫助對我們來說很重要。）

notes.title: 本課動詞變化提醒
notes.description: tell 和 fight 的過去式是不規則變化。plan 加 -ed 或 -ing 時要重複 n；train 不重複 n。這些單字變化可在例句中複習，選擇題仍以本課不定詞與動名詞句型為考點。
examples: The police officer told the boys to stop fighting.（警察叫男孩們停止打架。）
They planned to train together.（他們計畫一起訓練。）

quiz.question: The teenager wants ___ a famous singer in the future.
quiz.hint: wants 後面接不定詞 to V，表示想做的事；因此用 to become。

quiz.question: The factory worker needs ___ before he goes back to work.
quiz.hint: needs 後面的動作使用 to + 原形動詞，因此填 to rest。

quiz.question: The reporter planned ___ the actress yesterday, but she was too busy.
quiz.hint: planned 後接 to V；yesterday 影響主要動詞 planned，不會把 to interview 改成過去式。

quiz.question: My sister is learning ___ the guitar at school.
quiz.hint: learn 後接不定詞 to play；to 後面必須是原形動詞。

quiz.question: The writer decided ___ a story about a young police officer.
quiz.hint: decided 後接 to V；write 即使位於過去情境，放在 to 後仍用原形。

quiz.question: I would like ___ up with you for the music show.
quiz.hint: would like 後接不定詞 to V，所以用 to team；team up with 是本課片語素材。

quiz.question: The secretary asked the visitors ___ outside the office.
quiz.hint: 要求某人做事用 ask + 人 + to V；visitors 後應接 to wait。

quiz.question: The singer wanted us ___ with her during the last song.
quiz.hint: want + 人 + to V 表示想要某人做某事；us 後接 to sing。

quiz.question: The police officer told the boys ___ in the street because it was dangerous.
quiz.hint: 叫某人不要做事用 tell + 人 + not to V；危險的語境表示要求不要打架。

quiz.question: I need to sleep early, so I decided ___ up tonight.
quiz.hint: decide 後用不定詞，否定形式是 not to V。前句要早睡，故為 not to stay up。

quiz.question: The waitress enjoys ___ with the people at her tables.
quiz.hint: enjoy 後接動名詞 V-ing，因此使用 talking。

quiz.question: The singer kept ___ even when some people left the room.
quiz.hint: kept 是 keep 的過去式，後面仍接 V-ing；even when 表示她仍持續唱歌。

quiz.question: The actress practices ___ in front of a camera every day.
quiz.hint: practice 後接動名詞；dance 去掉字尾 e 再加 ing，成為 dancing。

quiz.question: Have some tea. I just finished ___ the last page of my report.
quiz.hint: finish 後面接 V-ing，不因 just finished 是過去式就改用 wrote。

quiz.question: The teenager quit ___ online games late at night because he needed more sleep.
quiz.hint: quit 表示放棄或停止某項活動時，後面接動名詞 playing。

quiz.question: The famous actor avoids ___ about his family in public.
quiz.hint: avoid 後接動名詞 V-ing，因此用 talking。

quiz.question: A: Do you mind ___ a few minutes? B: Not at all.
quiz.hint: mind 後面的動作使用 V-ing；Do you mind waiting...? 表示詢問是否介意等候。

quiz.question: A: Did the writer finish ___ the story? B: Yes, she did.
quiz.hint: Did 讓 finish 用原形，但 finish 後仍接動名詞 writing。

quiz.question: My brother does not enjoy ___ the drums alone.
quiz.hint: does not 改變主要動詞 enjoy 的形式，enjoy 後面仍須接 V-ing。

quiz.question: We have to keep ___ for the show, even when we feel tired.
quiz.hint: have to 後的 keep 已是原形；空格緊接 keep，應使用 practicing。

quiz.question: The reporter left without ___ for an answer.
quiz.hint: without 是介系詞，後面若接動作須用 V-ing，因此填 waiting。

quiz.question: Thank you for ___ me how to use this camera.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後面的動作使用動名詞 showing。

quiz.question: The little boy is afraid of ___ on stage by himself.
quiz.hint: 空格前的 of 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing；不是看到害怕就使用 to sing。

quiz.question: The teenager dreams of ___ a famous writer one day.
quiz.hint: dreams of 中的 of 是介系詞，後面用 becoming。

quiz.question: We talked about ___ a music club at school.
quiz.hint: about 是介系詞，後面用動名詞 starting；talked 的過去式不影響此規則。

quiz.question: She has a gift for ___ funny stories to children.
quiz.hint: for 後的動作須用 V-ing；telling stories 是動名詞片語，gift 表示天分。

quiz.question: The housewife likes ___ to music when she cooks.
quiz.hint: like 可接 V-ing 或 to V，但 to listening 不是 to V；四個選項中只有 listening 正確。

quiz.question: My grandparents love ___ photos of the stars at night.
quiz.hint: love 可接 to V 或 V-ing；選項中只有 to take 是正確形式，to taking 不是不定詞。

quiz.question: When the music came on, the actress began ___ with the children.
quiz.hint: begin 後可用 dancing 或 to dance；本題選項中只有 dancing 正確，過去式 danced 不能直接接在 began 後。

quiz.question: The factory workers started ___ the room after lunch.
quiz.hint: start 後可用 to clean 或 cleaning；選項中只有 to clean 符合規則。

quiz.question: The baby was asleep. Ben stopped ___ the drums, and the room became quiet.
quiz.hint: 房間變安靜，表示原本正在打鼓的動作停止了，使用 stop V-ing。

quiz.question: The mailman was walking in the hot sun. He felt tired, so he stopped ___ under a tree before walking on.
quiz.hint: 原本正在走路，停下來的目的是休息，再繼續走；使用 stop to V。

quiz.question: The boys were fighting. When the police officer arrived, they stopped ___ and stood quietly.
quiz.hint: 原本在打架，後來安靜站著，表示停止打架；用 stopped fighting。

quiz.question: On our walk home, we saw a beautiful bird. We stopped ___ a photo of it, then continued walking.
quiz.hint: 原本在走路，停下來是為了拍照；使用 stopped to take，而非停止原本正在進行的拍照動作。

quiz.question: A: What should I do before tomorrow's trip? B: Remember ___ your camera in your bag.
quiz.hint: 詢問明天出發前該做什麼，動作尚待執行；提醒記得要做用 remember to V。

quiz.question: I still remember ___ that singer at last year's show. She shook my hand.
quiz.hint: at last year's show 與握手的回憶表示已發生的經歷，使用 remember V-ing。

quiz.question: A: Is this your first time on a train? B: No. I remember ___ one with Dad when I was five.
quiz.hint: when I was five 指過去已發生的搭乘經驗；記得做過用 remember taking。

quiz.question: The camera has no power. I forgot ___ it last night, so I never plugged it in.
quiz.hint: never plugged it in 明確表示沒有充電，屬於忘記要做的事，使用 forgot to charge。

quiz.question: Amy had already paid for the gift, but she forgot ___ for it and tried to pay again.
quiz.hint: had already paid 與 pay again 表示已付過錢卻忘記做過；用 forgot paying。

quiz.question: I forgot ___ the letter this morning. It is still on my desk, and I never went to the post office.
quiz.hint: 信仍在桌上且沒去郵局，表示忘記寄而沒有寄出；用 forgot to send。

quiz.question: ___ the guitar with my friends is fun.
quiz.hint: 空格開始的整個活動作主詞，需要動名詞 Playing；另外三個選項不能這樣直接作主詞。

quiz.question: Taking pictures of movie stars ___ exciting for this young reporter.
quiz.hint: 主詞是 Taking pictures of movie stars 這一個活動，視為單數，搭配 is；不能看 pictures 或 stars 就選 are。

quiz.question: ___ a housewife takes a lot of time and work.
quiz.hint: 整個 Being a housewife 當 takes 的主詞，要用動名詞 Being。

quiz.question: Helping the new factory workers ___ important to our team.
quiz.hint: Helping the new factory workers 是一個動名詞片語主詞，搭配單數 is；workers 不是主要主詞。

quiz.question: Playing the guitar and writing stories ___ two different hobbies of mine.
quiz.hint: two different hobbies 清楚指出兩個獨立活動，主詞由 and 連接，使用複數 are。

quiz.question: It is exciting for the teenagers ___ their favorite singer.
quiz.hint: It is + 形容詞 + for 人 後接不定詞 to V，真正談的活動是 to meet their favorite singer。

quiz.question: ___ is not easy to become a famous actor.
quiz.hint: 後面有 to become 這個真正的主詞，前面使用虛主詞 It；There is 不用來構成這個句型。

quiz.question: It is important for us ___ one another when we have problems.
quiz.hint: It is important for us 後接 to V，表示互相幫助這件事很重要。

quiz.question: It is fun for ___ to play the drums together.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後面的人稱代名詞用受格 them；整句是 It is ... for 人 to V。

quiz.question: It is difficult for the secretary ___ all the work in one hour.
quiz.hint: It is difficult for 人 後面使用 to + 原形動詞，故為 to finish。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫明天跟我們組隊。

grammar.sentence: She has a gift for playing the drums.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她有打鼓的天分。

grammar.sentence: The factory worker stopped to drink some water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位工廠工人停下來喝了些水。

grammar.sentence: We decided not to stay up late tonight.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們決定今晚不要熬夜。

grammar.sentence: The reporter finished writing the story before dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位記者在晚餐前寫完了報導。

grammar.sentence: Playing the guitar is easy for that singer.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 彈吉他對那位歌手來說很容易。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 記得明天帶相機到學校。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位女演員每天和朋友們練習跳舞。

grammar.sentence: It is exciting to meet a famous writer.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 見到一位有名的作家令人興奮。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 警察叫男孩們不要打架。

grammar.sentence: My grandfather likes to watch the stars at night.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我爺爺喜歡在晚上看星星。

grammar.sentence: The teenagers kept singing after the music stopped.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 音樂停止後，青少年們繼續唱歌。

grammar.sentence: I remember meeting that popular singer last year.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我記得去年見過那位受歡迎的歌手。

grammar.sentence: Helping one another is important to our team.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 互相幫助對我們的團隊來說很重要。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位家庭主婦需要為這趟旅行存錢。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 謝謝你幫我搬這個鼓。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 很遺憾，他忘記買禮物給媽媽。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 表演開始時，孩子們停止了交談。

grammar.sentence: It is interesting for us to make funny videos.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 製作好笑的影片對我們來說很有趣。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 球員們必須為比賽持續訓練。

grammar.sentence: Singing and swimming are two different activities.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 唱歌和游泳是兩種不同的活動。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 這位作家開始告訴我們一個令人興奮的故事。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 郵差沒有帶著他的袋子就離開了。
